title: Session Summaries
content:
Session 31 - “King & Casino” 5/22/26

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib, Kronk

  • Meeting the Deepking. The Party entered the fortress and met with Deepking Horgar. They failed to get him to say how he knew to expect them, but he said they had a mutual friend. He offered to greatly reward them if they did a few quests for him:

    • Hunt down the remaining Cultists of Demogorgon throughout Gracklstugh.

    • Travel to Gravenhollow Library to meet a drow named Vizeran for help and knowledge.

    • Travel to Blingdenstone and Neverlight Grove to investigate rumors of demon influence.

  • Gifts. The Deepking openly gave them things they requested. Perry was given duergar Royal Guard +1 Half Plate armor. Kronk got duergar Royal Guard Full Plate armor. They got 5x potions that stave off the effects of Grackle-lung. They were given a Sending Stone to keep in touch with the Deepking.

  • Food and Drinks. The Party was offered stew and alcohol. Perry got especially sick from Underdrink, and Kronk got addicted to it.

  • Jibjib went to the bathroom. Asked dagon who told deepking about them. Got info but got a madness forcing him to hide in the bathroom the whole time.

  • Aetharn Casino. After sleeping again at the Inn, the Party went to the Casino to play Slots, Roulette, and especially Trolljack. Daterra won big. Jib did well too. Kronk lost every penny.

  • Sig Tipped Gnomes. The whole session, both at the Deepking and at the Casino, Sig made friends by giving tips to gnome servants.

  • Perry's wild night. At the Casino, Perry lost a lot, almost punched the dealer, got kicked out, played Hazard (Craps) out in an alley with other drunks, then spent the whole time outside the windows of the Casino.

  • Sig spotted a Cultist. At the Casino, Sig got wasted on alcohol, but then spotted a derro cultist of Demogorgon sneaking around behind the slot machines. It had sneaked in, following the Party. When spotted, it tried to flee.

  • Interrogating the Derro Cultist. Jib and Perry chased the derro, Kle running him down and Jib shackling him. Jib intimidated the derro and learned the whereabouts of the other cultists. They had been posing as exotic pet merchants around the Blade Bazaar and the docks. Shuushar, the new cult leader, sent derros like this one searching around town for the Party. This derro was ordered to kill or kidnap any of their pets to try to lure them into ambush. Perry finished the derro cultist off, taking its dagger as proof and identification.

  • Puzzle Box. Perry gambled a Marble and successfully got hints on how to use Radnelac's Puzzle Box. The Party finally learned they needed to ask it things or spell things with the marbles on top.

  • Mr. Sixx's Identity Revealed. Jibjib asked the Box who Mr. Sixx was. It spelled out Graz'zt. The Dark Prince, a Demon Lord on par with Demogorgon, Lolth, and Dagon.

  • Hologram Vision. The Puzzle Box made Perry's Marbles float in the air. With sand and dust gathering and swirling between the Marbles, they formed a hologram-like vision of past, present, and possible future if Graz'zt is not stopped. At the end of the vision, the Box gave a rhyme asking each Party member to swear a binding oath to fight against Graz'zt. It was clear that in order to get inside the Box, gain any rewards from it, and keep Ollie and his Copies as allies, the Party would need to swear an oath to fight each of the 8 figures on the box. Sig was the only one to refuse to swear to fight Graz'zt/Mr. Sixx. Sig was then blocked from helping with the Puzzle Box ever again. Everyone else swore to fight Graz'zt.

  • Next Time. We ended the session at the end of a long day of gambling, about to take a Long Rest back at the Inn again...


Session 30 - “Gracklstugh, City of Blades” 4/24/26

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib, Kronk

Before session 30, level up to Level 8!

  • West Cleft District. After being rescued by the Stone Guard, the Party exited the Whorlstone Tunnels and found themselves deep down at the bottom of a massive crevasse dividing the duergar city in half.

  • Leftenant Klyther's Badges. As they made the climb from this derro shantytown district up to the safer duergar districts, they talked to the leader of the Stone Guard, Leftenant Klyther Undrak. The dwarf gave them insignia badges that granted them access to restricted areas of the city. The dwarves then escorted them safely toward an Inn.

  • Drow Ambush. After passing walls dividing the restricted districts from the docks, a female Drow named Xalith tricked the Stone Guards into believing the Party were escaped slaves of her Mistress Ilvara Mizzrym. Daterra quickly sent JJ flying in, but another unseen drow sniped JJ.

  • Jibjib Chase. Xalith ran, and Jibjib was the only one fast enough to follow. Yet another drow sniper shot and missed Jib who shot double blasts back at him, exploding the guy's hand and then head in a casual 1-shot-kill. But in the process Jib lost Xalith in the crowd. Meanwhile, Perry, with the help of Kronk, convinced the gullible Leftenant Klyther to believe the Party over the drow.

  • The Ghohlbrorn's Lair Inn. The Party finally found a safe place to rest with duergar Stone Guards posted outside to protect them.

    • Jibjib did some reading and learned Narrak's cult rituals.

    • Daterra and Perry sent another Sending Stones message, and Sir Poem replied vague mad ramblings hinting at the riddles and secrets of the puzzle box.

    • Perry saw Marble memories of his past mentor Sir Mercy the teifling.

  • The Blade Bazaar. The next day, the Party went shopping, finally getting a chance to sell loot from their travels and make some money.

    • Perry worked at blacksmith. He started progressing toward proficiency with smith tools to make metal armor.

    • Kronk intimidated a shopkeeper and almost got in trouble with invisible duergar guards.

  • Fishing at the Docks. The Party played a minigame of fast rolling to catch fish. Jib was terrible at fishing, so frustrated he used Alter Shape and dived in to catch a fish by hand.

  • Jibjib spoke to Dagon. Jib stared into the Darklake water to converse with his patron Dagon. Jib got Madness (hemomania) but learned a bit about how the duergar Deepking knew to expect them here in Gracklstugh.

  • Perry Made a Deal with Daterra. While resting at the Inn again, Daterra melded spores with Perry and Shrump, unlocking a new Spore-Scarred Envelope and giving Perry the new title "Hag Seeker"

  • Grackl-lung. Kronk and Jib are starting to show signs of a lung sickness from spending time in the smog-filled dwarven city.

  • Next Time. We ended just arriving at the fortress for a meeting with Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V...


Session 29 - “Egg-scape from Demogorgon” 3/27/26

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib, Kronk

Before session 30, level up to Level 8!

  • The Chase Begins. With Shuushar attacking while Demogorgon broke his way through the cavern walls like the Kool-Aid Man, the Party was entered into an intense chase scene! Fleeing out of the first cavern, everyone quickly buffed up with potions, mushrooms, and spells. Jib and Kle the elk even flew around like Superman the whole time.

  • Circling the Map. Jibjib's intuition almost led them straight out the exit early on, only for them to backtrack away from it. They unknowingly circled the entire perimeter of the map.

  • Fungi Thicket. They encountered a Fungi Thicket where Daterra used Speak With Plants to ask the mushrooms to part way for them.

  • Rumpadump and the Myconids. Then they met a group of Myconids dancing eerily. The only one not dancing was the Myconid sprout Rumpadump, a friend of Shrump. They quickly rescued and took him with them.

  • Backtracking. In another cavern, they saw something scuttling along the ceiling while Demogorgon was trying to circle around and meet them from the front. So they backtracked.

  • Not Another Maze! Endless tunnels and forked paths left the Party screaming in frustration. Not the worst maze they've been in though.

  • Ambushed by Eyeballs. They hit a dead end at a massive cavern filled with tiered mesas and rocky cliffs. Atop one of the plateaus were ritualistic experiments and a table with a ruby-red dragon egg on it. The Party was ambushed here by dozens of creatures: numerous Nothics, cultists that had been twisted by dark magic into horrific single-eyed monsters obsessed with furthering progress in their sick experimentations; Notholders, small floating eyeball things that were a result of these experiments; and even a single Spectator, or lesser Beholder! All of these creatures attacked the Party with eye-beams shooting across the cavern.

  • The Dragon Egg. With Demogorgon closing in on them from the tunnel behind them, Sig, Daterra, and Perry all raced each other to the dragon egg. Perry, riding on a flying Kle, got there first, swooping down and scooping up the egg!

  • Marble Roulette. With things looking dire, a new mechanic was implemented where Perry could act as a "deus ex machina" and risk his marbles to try to help the Party escape. A roulette wheel was handed out, and Perry gambled multiple times! Though he lost 2 of his 8 marbles and is now nose-blind to dwarves, he was able to find a secret passage out of the dead end cavern.

  • Tiny Tunnels. With Demogorgon catching up to them at the dead end cavern, Daterra quickly had everyone take pygmy mushrooms, shrinking down to squeeze through the secret tunnel Perry found. Kle was the only one too big, and dozens of eye beams hit him like a slow-mo machinegun death scene in an action movie. The Party squeezed through the narrow tunnels, taking shortcuts through the map, and Demogorgon was unable to keep up in the bigger tunnels.

  • Runk the Derro. The Party returned to Runk the derro from last session and quickly intimidated him into telling them the way out of the west exit.

  • Rescued by Stone Guard. Down the final stretch to the exit tunnel, Demogorgon caught up to them! But just in time, they reached the exit and triggered the win condition cutscene. A platoon of duergar soldiers from the dwarven city above the tunnels rescued them! Stone Guards from Gracklstugh declared the Party under the protection of Deepking Horgar Steelshadow V. The dwarves escorted the Party to the safety of the city, and they caused cave-ins which blocked off Demogorgon and forced the demon lord to flee deeper into the dark depths away from Gracklstugh.

  • Next time. After being rescued by the Stone Guard, the Party is now free to rest in the capital city of the gray dwarves, Gracklstugh.


Session 28 - “It Was a Trap!” 2/6/26

Played this session: Daterra, Perry, Sig, Jibjib, Kronk

  • Sig recognized where they were: the Whorlstone Tunnels beneath the dwarven city Gracklstugh. Sig realized after Riftwalking here, it seemed to be a big coincidence that they happened to fall directly into a deadly pit of zombies.
  • Runk the Derro. After escaping the zombie pit, the Party had the little derro guy, named Runk, restrained. Runk was terrified and confused about Daterra's Demogorgon forehead scar, but he agreed to take them to his master, a derro named Narrak. But Runk refused to lead the way, scared of all the dangers in the tunnels.
  • Yellow Mold. The Party encountered Yellow Mold hazards that damaged Daterra. They were able to jump or toss everyone past.
  • Traps. Daterra fell into a pit trap in the ground. Then they found a Shrieker, a mushroom that screams in alarm when approached. Daterra was able to speak to the mushroom to silence it before it screamed.
  • Approaching the Cult Ritual. With Sig and Jib disguised as derros, and Kronk and Perry acting as Daterra's bodyguards, the Party convinced the derros that Daterra was a cult leader needing to talk to Narrak. This allowed them to get in close to a group of derros performing a demonic ritual in a huge magic circle. Perry then walked right up… and slapped Narrak in the face for not honoring “cult leader” Daterra!
  • Combat. Narrak and his derro cultists attacked using demonic tentacles and psychic attacks. A two-headed giant, or “ettin”, also attacked, but the Party avoided having a Death Dog loosed from its cage. Jibjib kept a safe distance, using blasts, summons, and Hunger of Hadar within the entire magic circle. Sig gave massive healing. Perry tanked up close. Daterra summoned an elemental but was then KO'd. Kronk also got targeted a ton, getting frozen by Hold Person. But then in the end Kronk was unleashed and slaughtered enemies, including killing Narrak and Spartan-kicking him backward into Jibjib's Hadar tentacle darkness. Epic.
  • The Ritual Magic Circle. The magic circle used by Narrak and the derros had a couple statues in the center. The cultists were doing some ritual to curse certain stone giants in the city above by making them grow second heads and go Mad.
  • Sig Madness. After combat, Sig did some mysterious rituals for Mr. Sixx. Walking within the cultist magic circle gave Sig a Madness that made him forget the existence of everyone around. Exhausted and confused, Sig simply set up camp in the corner of the cavern. Unsure what else to do, the rest of the Party rested there too.
  • Shuushar's Betrayal. During the night, Shuushar visited Kronk for one last "Jedi training" dream, telling him the tale of “the Tragedy of Belaphoss the Mad”, a lieutenant of Demogorgon. It was revealed that Shuushar had been fattening the Party up to sacrifice them to his master, Demogorgon! HE helped Jorlan the drow guard summon demons at Velkenvelve in the very beginning, helping the Party break out of prison... HE was the one that sacrificed his entire city of Sloobludop to Demogorgon when he summoned his master there... He was "leveled up" with better stats and granted the ability to speak Common by his master... He had been faking being a pacifish, being wise and enlightened and prophetic... HE was the one helping to divert Sig to Riftwalk right into a pit of zombies in the Whorlstone Tunnels when trying to Rift to Gracklstugh... It's always... been... a trap!
  • Demogorgon Summoned. Sig, still under the effects of Madness that made him forget the existence of everyone else, was bound in Shuushar's net in his sleep. Meanwhile Shuushar transformed -- his head splitting apart in two and tentacles sprouting all over! Shuushar managed to summon his master Demogorgon using the cultist ritual circle while the Party rested in the cavern.
  • Next Time. Demogorgon is currently breaking through the wall of the cavern, trying to get at the Party! Shuushar is attacking Sig and Kronk! The Party must now try to escape...
